anatomy.title: Anatomy of Persecution
anatomy.subtitle: The same episode has been confirmed by a court and declared a crime.
anatomy.text: The site breaks down the mechanism layer by layer: from commercial contracts to international procedures. Here you will find the documents that reveal not the parties' versions, but the objective contradictions.

legal.title: ⚖️ Legal Dissonance
legal.text: The arbitration system recognized the transaction as lawful and enforceable. The criminal apparatus classifies it as embezzlement.
legal.question: Can a legitimate court ruling be an 'instrument of crime'?

international.title: 🌍 International Perimeter
international.text: The Lagovsky case is no longer a local dispute. It has drawn Serbia, Interpol, and UN institutions into its orbit. It is now a test of how international law responds to politically motivated economic cases.

actors.title: 👥 Process Actors
actors.text: An interactive map of individuals: who initiated the case, who signed the expert assessments, and who provided the enforcement at different stages.
